title: Collectibles, Crews & Quests are here
summary: Our biggest update yet — new ways to stand out, team up and earn.
changes: **Nameplates** — an animated plate behind your name that shows everywhere: your page, comments, the leaderboard and crews
**Profile effects** — snow, sakura, embers, lightning, money rain and more play over your page when someone opens it
**Limited drops** — numbered collectibles with only 100 or 50 copies, shown on your profile with your serial (#12/100)
**Crews** — start a squad with your own tag next to every member's name, a crew page and a crew leaderboard
**Quests** — daily, weekly and one-time goals with tokens and collectibles you can't buy anywhere else
The **Daily Spin** can now drop collectibles, including spin-only ones
